Product.title: Product
Product.description: Represents a single handcrafted crochet product available in The Crochet Studio's inventory.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Product entity.

description.description: A detailed description of the product, including materials, size, and unique features.

price.description: The selling price of the product.

category.description: The category the product belongs to (e.g., 'Flowers', 'Amigurumi').

stockQuantity.description: The current quantity of the product available in stock.

imageUrls.description: An array of URLs pointing to images of the product.

tags.description: An optional array of descriptive tags.

isFeatured.description: A boolean indicating if the product should be displayed in featured sections.

isBestseller.description: A boolean indicating if the product is a bestseller.

isPublished.description: A boolean indicating if the product is visible to the public.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the product was first created.

updatedAt.description: The timestamp when the product was last updated.

params.name: productId
params.description: The unique identifier for a specific product document.
